verdict.rationale: CrewAI is an open-source Python framework installable locally via pip/uv (uv tool install crewai) with a CLI to create, run, and manage crews entirely on one's own infrastructure, with no evidence of mandatory cloud dependency for core functionality — enterprise/AMP features are separate add-ons. missing for 10: explicit self-hosting guide/documentation for production deployment, license clarity (OSS license type not stated), and independent confirmation of fully offline/self-hosted operation at scale.
